import csv
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
main = root / \"main.py\"

def run(args, *, ok=True):
    p = subprocess.run([\"python3\", str(main), *map(str, args)], text=True, capture_output=True)
    if ok and p.returncode "'!= 0:
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected failure {args}: {p.stderr}")
    if not ok and p.returncode == 0:
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected success {args}: {p.stdout}")
    return p

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    d = Path(td)
    source = d / "input.csv"
    source.write_text(
        '"'team,item,amount,note\\r\\n'
        'b,\"widget, large\",1.20,\"two\\nlines\"\\r\\n'
        'a,small,2.30,ok\\r\\n'
        'b,small,1.80,ok\\r\\n',
        encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\"
    )
    original = source.read_bytes()

    p = run([source, \"--where\", \"item=widget, large\"])
    assert json.loads(p.stdout) == [{\"team\":\"b\", \"item\":\"widget, large\", \"amount\":\"1.20\", \"note\":\"two\\nlines\"}]

    p = run([source, \"--group-by\", \"team\", \"--sum\", \"amount\", \"--avg\", \"amount\"])
    assert json.loads(p.stdout) == [
        {\"team\":\"a\", \"sum_amount\":\"2.3\", \"avg_amount\":\"2.3\"},
        {\"team\":\"b\", \"sum_amount\":\"3\", \"avg_amount\":\"1.5\"},
    ]

    p = run([source, \"--where\", \"note=ok\", \"--group-by\", \"team\", \"--sum\", \"amount\", \"--output\", \"csv\"])
    assert list(csv.reader(p.stdout.splitlines())) == [
        [\"team\", \"sum_amount\"], [\"a\", \"2.3\"], [\"b\", \"1.8\"]
    ]
    assert source.read_bytes() == original

    p = run([source, \"--group-by\", \"team\"])
    assert len(json.loads(p.stdout)) == 3

    bad_cases = {
        \"duplicate.csv\": \"a,a\\n1,2\\n\",
        \"empty_header.csv\": \"a,\\n1,2\\n\",
        \"short.csv\": \"a,b\\n1\\n\",
        \"long.csv\": \"a,b\\n1,2,3\\n\",
        \"bad_quote.csv\": 'a,b\\n1,\"unterminated\\n',
        \"invalid_num.csv\": \"g,n\\nx,nope\\n\",
        \"blank_num.csv\": \"g,n\\nx,\\n\",
        \"empty.csv\": \"\",
    }
    for name, content in bad_cases.items():
        path = d / name
        path.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\")
        args = [path]
        if name in {\"invalid_num.csv\", \"blank_num.csv\"}:
            args += [\"--group-by\", \"g\", \"--sum\", \"n\"]
        p = run(args, ok=False)
        assert p.stderr.strip(), (name, p)
    for args in (
        [source, \"--where\", \"broken\"],
        [source, \"--where\", \"missing=x\"],
        [source, \"--sum\", \"amount\"],
        [source, \"--group-by\", \"missing\", \"--sum\", \"amount\"],
        [source, \"--group-by\", \"team\", \"--sum\", \"missing\"],
        [source, \"--output\", \"xml\"],
    ):
        run(args, ok=False)

print(\"self-tests passed\")
